name: How long does an insulation upgrade project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an insulation upgrade project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an insulation upgrade project depends on the scope of work. A typical attic insulation upgrade for an average-sized home can often be completed within one to two days. Projects involving wall cavities, crawl spaces, or requiring removal of old insulation may take longer, potentially three to five days. We strive to complete projects efficiently with minimal disruption to your daily routine, and we'll provide a clear timeline during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most insulation upgrades, like an attic re-insulation, take 1-2 days. More extensive projects involving walls or removal may take 3-5 days.
